page_title: JUV 1-1 EMP | Juventus v Empoli 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Nicolo Cambiaghi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Razvan Marin (Empoli).
90+3' Caution goes to Timothy Weah (Juventus).
90+2' Livio Marinelli interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
90+2' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

90+1' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' That's the end of the game for Szymon Zurkowski, who is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).
88' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
87' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
87' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play and Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Livio Marinelli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Federico Gatti (Juventus) and blew his whistle.
82' The resulting corner from Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) is cleared.

82' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a brilliant save. The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
79' The resulting corner, taken by Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli), comes to nothing.
79' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
78' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Filip Kostic and he is replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
78' It is time for a substitution. Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) is on for Andrea Cambiaso.
77' Filip Kostic (Juventus) is about to take a corner kick.
75' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
75' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
70' 1 - 1 Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
69' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box.
67' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
64' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) but poses no threat.
59' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Timothy Weah (Juventus) replacing Fabio Miretti.
57' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' Here is a change. Alberto Cerri is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli).
56' That will be all from Alberto Grassi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).

56' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. It will be a corner kick for Empoli.
50' 1 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
50' A cross into the box from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is cleared. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
47' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alberto Cerri (Empoli) heads on.
46' The whistle blows and Livio Marinelli starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) fails to keep his cool and squanders a golden chance to score from inside the penalty area after firing the ball over the crossbar.
45+1' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
41' Alex Sandro (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Empoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
37' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Fabio Miretti (Juventus). The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
33' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:2.
28' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
28' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

26' That was a nice football moment. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Wojciech Szczesny guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

24' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Livio Marinelli with no other option than to blow for a foul.
20' Livio Marinelli shows the yellow card to Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) for a heavy challenge.
16' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
15' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus)! Let's see what he decides.
15' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
14' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) makes a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Livio Marinelli has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
12' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile shows his agility and makes a save.
11' It looks like Bremer (Juventus) saw red with that tackle. Livio Marinelli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
7' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

6' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the right side of the goal but for a magnificent save by Elia Caprile. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
4' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

1' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is aimed towards the middle of the net, but Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Livio Marinelli.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
